integrity: The statements are proved by explicit gap bijections, formal series extraction, and Stirling asymptotics. Finite code checks are corroborative rather than proofs. No independent review or priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The target deletion pattern consists only of copies of one distinguished symbol.
Uniform probability is conditional on the exact distinguished-symbol count, not i.i.d. letters.
The asymptotic rate compares expectation to maximum at an equal split of positions.
The published elementary balancing identity is acknowledged as prior; only conditional moments and their exponential gap are assessed as new.
Historical equivalence to general weak-composition moment identities is a residual risk.
title: Fixed-composition moment laws and an exponential extremal gap for monochromatic complement deletions
